title: The Ascent of Light through the Gates and Firmaments
description: Rays of light reach down through great gates standing open in the firmaments, arrayed across the four climes; through these gates of shining-forth they take by the hand the light mingled in the threefold strongholds, and a sorting is performed: one kind borne upward to the upper place, to the Living Ones; the other consigned to the whole lower side. The cosmic mechanism by which captive light is extracted firmament by firmament.
